source: La Porte du Soleil pilot (runs/pilot) + tests + reports

entries.observation: STILL_ANIMATABLE shot (SC15-SH01) routed to a VIDEO model produced a cartoon render
entries.evidence: SC15-v1 cartoon vs SC15-v2 flux-dev photoreal; shot-list mediaCategory=STILL_ANIMATABLE
entries.cause: CONFIRMED: model/category mis-route
entries.rule: Route strictly by canonical mediaCategory (STILL->flux-dev, VIDEO->minimax)

entries.observation: No explicit photoreal anchor → style can drift
entries.evidence: anchor added; SC48/SC22/SC15-v2/SC39-v2 all photoreal
entries.cause: INFERRED (anchor + correct routing both applied)
entries.rule: applyStyle() photoreal anchor on every visual prompt

entries.observation: Astrid forearm star mark flagged as anachronism
entries.evidence: authored prompt: "star-chart tattoo on her forearm"
entries.cause: CONFIRMED: it is CANON, not an anachronism (my earlier flag was wrong, retracted)
entries.rule: Check canon before flagging anachronism; never auto-edit authored prompts

entries.observation: Dense crowd / background faces deform (SC22)
entries.evidence: SC22 background faces melted (visual inspection)
entries.cause: OBSERVED: known generative crowd-artifact
entries.rule: Limit dense crowds per shot; keep crowds mid/background soft; flag for human; prefer fewer hero faces

entries.observation: Timeout with unknown billing could free budget
entries.evidence: adapter catch-all released reservation on any error
entries.cause: CONFIRMED defect, FIXED
entries.rule: Post-creation timeout => INDETERMINATE_BILLING, keep reservation, HALT, no auto-retry

entries.observation: Identity not enforced in generation (text-only)
entries.evidence: pilot shots text-only; faces not locked
entries.cause: CONFIRMED
entries.rule: Inject subject_reference (video)/image (still) for an UNAMBIGUOUS single covered character

entries.observation: CIQE rejected silent generated video on audio-absence
entries.evidence: SC15/SC22 REJECTED_CIQE only on audio_presence
entries.cause: CONFIRMED: final-film audio gate misapplied to generation shots
entries.rule: Generation shots judged on VISUAL/TECHNICAL only; audio added in post

entries.observation: Reserve-before-call + persistent cap + 8-attempt limit held
entries.evidence: ledger never exceeded; €1.53/€6.08; resume no double-charge
entries.cause: CONFIRMED (positive)
entries.rule: Keep ODG-side reserve-before-call + persistent ledger as the spend control

entries.observation: Three concurrent character registries disagreed with disk truth (identity-registry said ASTRID ref=NONE; dossier said 3 real refs; visual-references-status said 0 produced)
entries.evidence: runs/pilot/refs has ASTRID/MERYT/OLAF.webp with computed sha256; the three JSONs each stated a different reference status
entries.cause: CONFIRMED: concurrent, unsynchronized registries with no single source of truth; reference status was asserted, not recomputed from disk
entries.rule: One SSOT (character-registry-f10.json) with immutable CHAR-### ids; reference sha256 always recomputed from disk, never inherited; superseded registries marked non-authoritative
entries.test: character-registry.test.mjs (ref sha256 matches disk; deterministic rebuild; frozen id snapshot)

entries.observation: Reputation leaders (Veo 3.1/Kling v3/Seedance 2.5) are newer SKUs than the versions actually callable on our Replicate; only minimax/video-01 offers a true subject_reference for recurring-character identity
entries.evidence: Replicate OpenAPI schemas 2026-10-24 vs 2026 roundups/arena; model-comparison-f10.json evidence tiers
entries.cause: CONFIRMED: general reputation != verified quality for our exact shots/version
entries.rule: Select on VERIFIED capability (subject_reference, camera control, our pilot inspection) + cost-per-ACCEPTED-result; prove reputation claims with a bounded authorized head-to-head before committing a model
entries.test: model-comparison-f10.json (per-criterion evidence tier) ; head-to-head proposed, not yet run

entries.observation: The action-rework SC38 movement contract ('Meryt disarms Seth-Nakht / khopesh lost') describes a beat that does NOT exist in the canonical SC38 shot-list ('Astrid takes the field'; chars ASTRID/OLAF/TOVE; Meryt absent)
entries.evidence: shot-list-f10.json SC38 video shots vs f10-movement-contracts.json SC38 contract; sc38-acceptance-gate.json CANON_DISCREPANCY_FLAG
entries.cause: CONFIRMED: a derived artifact (movement contract) drifted from the canonical shot-list without a flag
entries.rule: Cross-check every derived contract/plan against the canonical shot-list; a mismatch is a PROPOSED change (flag, do not silently apply); test the canon by default
entries.test: sc38-acceptance-gate.json flags it; shot-continuity-bindings built from shot-list ground truth, not the contract

entries.observation: The 3 SC38 candidates do NOT accept the same identity conditioning (minimax=subject_reference; seedance=image+last_frame; veo-3-fast=image only) and SC38's canonical video shots are multi-character, so subject_reference conditions only one subject
entries.evidence: Replicate OpenAPI schemas 2026-10-24; sc38-acceptance-gate.json candidateConditioning + fairnessStatement
entries.cause: CONFIRMED: assuming equal reference inputs would make an unfair/invalid comparison
entries.rule: Give each model its BEST available identity mechanism and record the asymmetry; never silently substitute a different task to force parity

entries.observation: SC01 opening rendered OFF-CANON (a golden city) instead of a North-Sea storm at night
entries.evidence: 0 of 13 SC01 shot prompts contain storm/night/wave/no-city; the prompt was generic ('establishing — NORTH SEA … Egyptian gold/ochre'); scene-registry SC01 status=TO_FIX; off-canon media on disk
entries.cause: CONFIRMED (reproducible): prompt under-specification — no scene anchors + a stray 'gold/ochre' colour cue steered the model to a cityscape
entries.rule: Every PREMIUM_VIDEO/establishing prompt must carry explicit canonical anchors (time-of-day, weather, key objects) AND negative constraints (no city/buildings/modern/text); generic 'establishing — <LOCATION>' prompts are rejected
entries.test: sc01-prompt-guard.test.mjs (locks corrected-spec anchors + exclusions; forward guard on SC01 prompts)

entries.observation: A provider's duration DEFAULT can silently inflate cost past a ceiling (google/veo-3-fast default=8s, enum [4,6,8]); $0.15/s × 8 × 2 + minimax = $3.40 would exceed €3.00
entries.evidence: live OpenAPI schema 2026-10-24; sc38-pilot-plan-final.json COST_REVISION
entries.cause: CONFIRMED: relying on a model's default duration instead of pinning it
entries.rule: ALWAYS pin duration explicitly on every paid call; compute worst-case at the PINNED duration with an adverse FX + fee buffer; refuse any call that would breach the hard USD cap

entries.observation: CORRECTION to L10: 'only minimax/video-01 has reference-image conditioning' was INCOMPLETE. bytedance/seedance-2.5 (and 2.0, 1-lite) on our Replicate expose reference_images[] (multi-reference) — stronger for a recurring cast than minimax's single subject_reference. seedance-2.5 caps at 720p, ~$0.1028/s.
entries.evidence: Replicate OpenAPI schemas + price page, read-only 2026-10-24; epic-ai-films-benchmark.json OUR_REPLICATE_RECONCILED
entries.cause: CONFIRMED: an earlier census probed only seedance-1-pro, not the 2.x line → incomplete capability map
entries.rule: Re-probe the FULL model line (not one SKU) before concluding a capability is unique; reconcile vendor headline specs (e.g. Seedance 2.5 '50 assets/30s/1080p') against OUR provider (720p-only on Replicate)

entries.observation: Benchmark discipline: view counts (Epic AI Films '73.6m as of 2026-10-23', creator-claimed) do NOT imply retention, revenue, or profit; and a vendor/aggregator 'they use Seedance 2.5' claim was NOT stated on the creator's own page
entries.evidence: epicaifilms.com/about fetched 2026-10-24 (no model named); search-summary view figures varied (55.6m vs 73.6m) by date/source
entries.cause: CONFIRMED (positive discipline): separate VERIFIED_PUBLIC vs CREATOR_CLAIM vs THIRD_PARTY vs NOT_ACCESSED; never infer economics from views; never claim footage was watched
entries.rule: Every quantitative benchmark figure carries a source + date + tier; mark video/analytics NOT_ACCESSED when they genuinely are; derive only testable creative/distribution choices

entries.observation: Full-film cost estimate (420 shots): baseline ~$149/€138, optimized ~$79/€73 (−47%), max-reduction ~$42/€39 (−72%). BUT the headline savings mix two kinds.
entries.evidence: full-film-cost-model.mjs + full-film-cost-analysis.json (prices VERIFIED 2026-10-24); inventory 64 PV/196 still/141 audio/19 music
entries.cause: CONFIRMED method: separate PROVEN-arithmetic savings (routing/reuse/Ken-Burns, computed from verified prices at 1 attempt = 28% B / 57% C) from HYPOTHESIS retry-rate savings (unmeasured acceptance → the rest of the headline)
entries.rule: Report cost savings in two tiers: proven-arithmetic (price-based, no acceptance assumption) vs hypothesis (retry/acceptance-dependent). Never present a hypothesis-dependent total as guaranteed; measure acceptance in a bounded validation before authorizing full-film spend
entries.test: full-film-production-strategy.json savingsProvenVsHypothesis; cost model is reproducible

entries.observation: Quality-aware router must filter models that MEET the identity/resolution need FIRST, then minimize cost among qualifiers — never pick a cheaper model that fails a need. Conflicts (e.g. multi-identity AND 1080p: no single model) resolve quality-first (keep identity, flag the resolution tradeoff for human sign-off).
entries.evidence: quality-router.mjs + quality-router.test (18/18); seedance-2.5=multi-ref@720p vs veo-3-fast=1080p/start-frame tradeoff
entries.cause: CONFIRMED design: cost-minimization without a quality precondition would silently downgrade identity/resolution
entries.rule: Route = (filter by quality/identity/resolution need) → (cheapest-qualifying); when no model satisfies all needs, keep the higher-value quality dim and FLAG the tradeoff — do not auto-trade quality for price. Instrument acceptance + cost-per-accepted via cost-ledger-schema (never fabricate).

entries.observation: REAL paid fair test (same shot/ref/prompt): seedance-2.5 + a 768px-resized ASTRID ref reproduced the reference FACE + canon costume + star-chart sleeve motif and held identity across frames; minimax/video-01 subject_reference gave a plausible but DIFFERENT, younger face + generic garb. Also: seedance E005 'sensitive' on person refs is fixed by resizing the ref to ≤768px wide (documented, not evasion).
entries.evidence: runs/validation-av/C1-seedance2.5-ref768.mp4 + C2-minimax-subjectref768.mp4 + av-fair-compare-decision.json; ODG viewed mid+first+last frames; €3.30/€6 spent, cap respected, pilot ledger untouched
entries.cause: CONFIRMED on ONE shot: seedance reference_images (with a correctly-sized ref) is the stronger identity+canon path; the earlier E005 blocks were the reference pixel-width/face-size, not the prompt
entries.rule: CHARACTER/IDENTITY shots → seedance-2.5 reference_images with refs RESIZED ≤768px wide + canon locks in the prompt (steering-oar not wheel, canon garb, tattoo); minimax subject_reference = fallback; environmental/wide → seedance text-only. Full-motion identity + audio + multi-char remain HUMAN_REQUIRED
entries.confidence: MEDIUM-HIGH (one shot, multi-frame visual review; not full-motion/audio)

entries.observation: TRANCHE-1 (real paid, €15 cap, €3.40 spent): seedance-2.5 reference_images E005-REJECTS our Björn MALE face (reproduced ×6, even weapon-free @768px) — but minimax/video-01 subject_reference ACCEPTS it and held Björn identity consistently across 5 shots. Astrid's face passed seedance; Björn's did not (provider filter variance). So Björn's identity pipeline = minimax (single-subject). Multi-char (Björn+Astrid) in one shot stays unsolved (minimax=single; seedance rejects Björn). Prompt-tightening ('wool tunic not bare chest' + 'single enormous two-handed greatsword') fixed costume/weapon drift (A2b→A2b-v2).
entries.evidence: runs/production-t1/ (bjorn refs + A1b/A2b/A2b-v2/A3b/A4b.mp4 + tranche1-bilan.json); ODG viewed mid-frames (identity consistent; A1b+A4b strong; greatsword drifts without strong prompting)
entries.cause: CONFIRMED: seedance face-filter is unreliable per-face; minimax is the robust single-subject identity path for Björn
entries.rule: Björn identity → minimax/video-01 subject_reference (weapon-free 768px ref); lock canon in the prompt (wool tunic, explicit greatsword, steering-oar); for multi-char identity use a composed first-frame or accept one-conditioned subject; re-roll on canon drift. Full-motion/cinematic acceptance = HUMAN.
entries.confidence: HIGH (pipeline/E005 reproduced); identity-quality MEDIUM (single-frame review, human-pending)

notToRepeat: inheriting a reference status instead of recomputing sha256 from disk
confusing model reputation with verified quality for our exact shots
